latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-act-risk-check.
- Provides a quick risk classification for AI systems per Annex III of the EU AI Act.
- Outputs HIGH-RISK or LOW-RISK with applicable high-risk category.
- No dependencies; uses only shell scripts and LLM inference.

raw_record.summary: Assesses AI system risk polarity based on Annex III of the EU AI Act, identifying high-risk categories like biometrics and employment.
